slots.name: .input-group
slots.description: Root container with border, background, and flex layout. Uses `min-h-9` for flexible height and `items-center` by default, switching to `items-start` when a textarea is present.

slots.name: .input-group__input
slots.description: Input element with transparent background and no border. Also used as the base class for textarea elements.

slots.name: .input-group__prefix
slots.description: Prefix container with left border radius. Aligns to top when used with textarea.

slots.name: .input-group__suffix
slots.description: Suffix container with right border radius. Aligns to top when used with textarea.

slots.name: .input-group--secondary
slots.description: Secondary variant without shadow, suitable for use in surfaces
